backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a social media backend defining types and logic for posts, comments, user profiles, notifications, messaging, follows, and friend requests, with authorization and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three frontend bug-fix features (ProfilePage data loading, backend query wiring, and CreatePostPage submission) to their relevant files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and notable recent changes.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based light and dark theme CSS custom properties for colors, borders, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that sets the page title to 'Smileup' and mounts the React app via the root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app in ThemeProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and QueryClientProvider, showing a loading splash, LandingPage for unauthenticated users, or the full router for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AvatarPlaceholde: Reusable avatar component that renders a profile picture from an ExternalBlob URL or falls back to a gradient circle with initials, supporting multiple size variants and both legacy and new prop names.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with six icon links (Home, Explore, ShortSport, Messages, Create, Profile), active-state highlighting, and a dot badge on Messages when conversations exist; hidden on the ShortSport route.
frontend/src/components/CommentsSheet.ts: A bottom sheet component for displaying and submitting comments on a post, supporting both open/onOpenChange and isOpen/onClose prop conventions.
frontend/src/components/editor/AudioPane: An editor panel for managing audio tracks, supporting file upload and a mock record toggle, with per-track volume sliders, mute, and remove controls.
frontend/src/components/editor/DesignPan: A React panel component for editing canvas design properties including aspect ratio, background color/gradient presets, shape overlays, and decorative elements. Exposes controls that update the shared EditorState via an onUpdate callback.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorCan: A canvas-based preview component that renders the current editor state including background color, text layers, sticker layers, filter CSS, vignette gradient, glitch, and letterbox effects using the HTML5 Canvas API.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorTim: A timeline UI component that displays video/image/blank clips on a scrollable ruler with a draggable playhead, supports scrubbing, clip removal, and adding new blank clips.
frontend/src/components/editor/EffectsPa: A panel for toggling visual motion-graphics effects (confetti, glitch, letterbox, etc.) on the editor state, displaying active effects as tags and available effects as a grid of toggle buttons.
frontend/src/components/editor/ExportPan: A panel for exporting and sharing the edited video, providing title/description metadata fields, a video preview, and a download button that creates a blob URL from the provided video File.
frontend/src/components/editor/FiltersPa: A panel offering preset filter styles and individual slider controls (brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, vignette, etc.) that update the FilterSettings portion of EditorState, with a reset-to-defaults option.
frontend/src/components/editor/StickersP: A React panel component for adding and managing emoji sticker layers on a video editor, supporting categorized emoji selection, sticker placement with random positioning, and controls for size, rotation, and timing.
frontend/src/components/editor/TextPanel: A React panel component for adding and editing text layers in a video editor, with controls for font, size, color, bold/italic, alignment, animation, and timing per layer.
frontend/src/components/editor/Transitio: A React panel component that displays a library of video transitions and allows users to apply specific transitions between consecutive clips in the editor state.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a TopBar, main content outlet, and BottomNav.
frontend/src/components/NotificationsPan: A dropdown panel that lists user notifications (follows, messages) with avatars, timestamps, and click-to-navigate behavior, marking them as read on interaction.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Displays a single post with author info, media (image/video), like/comment/share/bookmark actions, optimistic like updates, and intersection-observer-based view recording.
A dialog modal that shows a grid of the current user's posts as thumbnails, allowing selection of one to share in a message.
frontend/src/components/ShareModal.tsx: A dialog for sharing a post with selected friends via direct messages, showing a friend list with toggle selection and bulk send functionality.
frontend/src/components/StoriesRow.tsx: A horizontally scrollable stories row showing the current user's story button with a popup menu and mock stories from other users that open a viewer modal on tap.
frontend/src/components/StoryViewerModal: A full-screen modal component for viewing a single story, displaying the user's avatar, name, handle, timestamp, and a progress bar, with Escape key and backdrop-click dismissal.
frontend/src/components/TopBar.tsx: A sticky top navigation bar showing the Smileup wordmark, notification bell with unread badge, search button, and sign-out control, hiding itself on the '/shortsport' route.
frontend/src/components/TrendingProfiles: A horizontally scrollable section that fetches and displays the top 10 trending creator cards with rank, avatar, follower count, and a profile navigation button, including loading skeletons and an empty state.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A card component for displaying a video post with thumbnail, play button, duration badge, like/comment/share/bookmark actions, and a double-tap like animation.
frontend/src/components/YourStoryPopup.t: A small dropdown popup anchored below the user's story avatar offering two actions: viewing the user's own posts or creating a new post, with outside-click dismissal.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook for React, managing login/logout state, identity persistence via AuthClient, and delegation validity checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including posts, comments, user profiles, and social features using the ICP actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Inter and Syne fonts, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes using OKLCH color values, and adds utility classes for glassmorphism, scrollbar hiding, and gradient text effects.
frontend/src/lib/mockData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and mock data arrays for core app entities including Posts, Comments, Users, Stories, Messages, and Conversations, used for development and UI prototyping.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides utility functions for class name merging (cn), number formatting (K/M suffixes), time formatting (mm:ss), and relative time display (timeAgo).
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app with QueryClientProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and the root App component into the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page component for creating new posts supporting photo, video, GIF, and text media types, with file upload or URL input, caption entry, and submission via the createPost mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Full-featured video/design editor page that manages editor state (clips, text layers, stickers, audio, filters, effects) and renders a panel-based UI with tools for trimming, filters, effects, stickers, design, and export.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Explore page with a debounced search input and tabs for browsing/searching posts or users, fetching data via useGetAllPosts and useSearchUsers hooks and rendering results with navigation to user profiles.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays the main social feed with stories, trending profiles, and a sorted list of posts. Handles loading skeletons, error states, empty states, and opens a comments sheet on post interaction.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Unauthenticated landing page for Smileup showing a branded login button powered by Internet Identity. Includes a tagline, feature highlights, and a footer with attribution.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Full messaging UI with conversation list, message thread view, friend requests tab, and the ability to send text messages or share posts. Includes unread counts, time formatting, and post-picker modal.
frontend/src/pages/MessageThreadPage.tsx: Thin wrapper page that extracts a principalId from route params and renders MessagesPage with that principal pre-selected.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page showing avatar, stats (followers/following), and a grid of the user's posts with edit profile functionality and logout support.
frontend/src/pages/ShortSportPage.tsx: TikTok-style short video feed with vertical scrolling, auto-play/pause, mute toggle, auto-scroll on video end, like, comment, and share actions per video item.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: Displays a user's public profile page with follow/unfollow and friend request actions, showing posts, follower/following counts, and profile info fetched by principal or handle.
frontend/src/routeTree.ts: Defines the TanStack Router route tree for the app, mapping paths like '/', '/explore', '/profile/$handle', '/user/$principal', and '/messages/$principalId' to their respective page components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL query parameters (including hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, typography/container-query plugins, custom fonts (Inter, Syne), and extended border radii and shadows.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state for Smileup, documenting two known critical bugs (profile page stuck in skeleton loading and post creation failures) and the corresponding fix feature requests.
